name: spawn_selected_object_effect

stack.evidence: func_001E09E0 consumes one effect ID, stores it in an event-effect task record, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001E09E0 queues dispatcher state 7 with the Script-bound object. State 7 resolves effect_id from the effect package referenced by that object, spawns the PPP effect at the object's current position through func_001779A0, and retains it in an eight-slot attachment table that updates the effect from the live object transform. The JP corpus contains 32 calls; representative reward scripts pass effect ID 1.
